candidates.lead: Youth Allowance is the Centrelink payment for full-time students, Australian Apprentices and job seekers aged 16 to 24; Austudy covers students aged 25 and over. From 1 January 2026 the maximum is $482.40 a fortnight for a single 18-or-over living at home and $677.20 away from home or on Austudy [[YOUTH_ALLOWANCE_STUDENT.maxFortnightly]]; income over $539 a fortnight reduces it [[STUDENT_INCOME_TEST.freeArea]].

A youth allowance calculation applies the student personal income test to the maximum fortnightly rate: income up to $539 is free, the payment falls 50 cents per dollar from $539 to $646, then by $53.50 plus 60 cents per dollar above $646 [[STUDENT_INCOME_TEST]]. On the 1 January 2026 rates, a student living away from home starts at $677.20 and reaches $0 at $1,697.17 [[YOUTH_ALLOWANCE_STUDENT.publishedCutOff]].

Youth Allowance and Austudy rates are set by Services Australia and indexed on 1 January [[YOUTH_ALLOWANCE_STUDENT.indexedOn]]: from 1 January 2026, $418.90 a fortnight for a single under 18 at home, $482.40 at 18 or older at home, $677.20 away from home or on Austudy, and $854.20 with children [[YOUTH_ALLOWANCE_STUDENT.maxFortnightly]]. Income over $539 a fortnight reduces the payment.
